content.short: StraitsX issues Singapore dollar, US dollar and Indonesian rupiah stablecoins and runs payment rails on them.
content.description: StraitsX issues XSGD against the Singapore dollar, XUSD against the US dollar and XIDR against the Indonesian rupiah, which makes it one of the few issuers whose main products are not dollar denominated. That regional focus is the point, since a Southeast Asian business settling in its own currency avoids a round trip through dollars and the cost attached. On top of the tokens it runs card issuing, fund transfers and QR payments that connect to local schemes. It is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore under several major payment institution licences.
